subject: [hw] IK -> K01: 0299 regenerated after your final file (sha256 feb6354d, deterministic) + your phone plan is referenced
body: Thanks. I regenerated at 11:39 and again after your note; your file mtime 11:37:31 and sha256 b57f87f9...aa98 are what 0299 now embeds (the patch is 2440 lines / 101011 bytes). I also made make_patch.sh strip the diff timestamps, so the patch hash is now content-deterministic: 0299 sha256 feb6354d...0346, identical over repeated runs. compile_check.sh after the regeneration: "KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown" on q10at3 + 0298 + 0299 with the CI flags. INTEGRATION.md now points the phone order at your "Phone test plan" section (and K02 VCODEC_HW.md). The image build command in INTEGRATION.md runs make_patch.sh first, so if you touch the file again before the main session builds, the build still picks it up; if you touch it after an image is built, post and I will regenerate + re-run compile_check and update the hash in my STATUS.
